text: The Always-On Search campaign on Google converted ad clicks into purchase for Adizero SL, acting as the last touch point of the advertising journey.
Adidas activated the Spring Lifestyle Video campaign through Instagram to promote Gazelle OG and generate consumer demand.
The New Year Running Performance Push campaign underperformed in user traffic generation, leading to weak revenue and low ROAS despite retargeting; the creative needs to be revisited.
The CRM Spring Activation campaign on Salesforce boosted sales with direct emails to Adidas members better than social retargeting campaigns, proving Salesforce again as the strongest CRM tool.
The DOOH push in May executed via JCDecaux reached 25 million consumers on the flagship Berlin digital signage and increased event awareness for the Samba OG launch.
The Summer Retail Promo campaign improved product discovery for Ultraboost Light across Meta.
The Women Training Social Video campaign on Instagram delivered only average click-through and low purchase conversion against its brand awareness objectives.
In January, the New Year Lifestyle Content Push campaign on Instagram delivered a 1.1% CTR, close to the brand benchmark but with limited lower-funnel impact at 692 conversions.
The New Year Brand Social Video on YouTube gained over 5.2 million impressions, yet its 0.34% CTR and moderate VTR indicated weak creative resonance for an awareness-focused video.
The Always-On Search campaign on Google was the strongest January performance driver, achieving ROAS 11.1 and 105,234 conversions for Adizero SL.
Although the New Year Running Performance Push retargeting through Meta achieved 40,200 clicks, its ROAS of 0.3 showed that the audience was not warm enough to convert.
Criteo retargeting for New Year Running Performance Push generated consistent traffic but returned ROAS 0.1, indicating inefficiency despite steady click volume.

In 2025, Adidas Germany spent €101.5M on marketing and generated €835.2M in attributed revenue, with the Footwear Performance Push_influencer campaign in May and the Year-End promotions in December driving the biggest sales peaks.
Across 2025, the Digital Performance team delivered the strongest commercial contribution with ROAS 1480%, acting as the primary last-click conversion engine for Adidas.com.
The CRM team achieved ROAS 1097% from a small member base, showing that the Adidas Membership Program effectively turns demand generation into repeat purchases.
Brand Offline activities such as TV, OOH, and DOOH absorbed 31% of annual spend and generated 33% of revenue, fulfilling their role as broad-reach consideration drivers.
In January, the New Year Brand TVC on RTL delivered 320 GRPs and strong national exposure, while the ProSieben flight added a further 270 GRPs for incremental reach.
In March, the Spring DOOH campaign on JCDecaux reached 8.1 million people at frequency 5 and produced about €4.2M in revenue, matching the impact of parallel OOH and TV flights.
In 2025, continued growth of Adidas.com D2C ecommerce meant that digital campaigns run by Digital Performance and Digital Brand together contributed 49% of all marketing-attributed revenue.
OOH and TV together accounted for over 40% of annual marketing spend, delivering stable frequency levels of around 5 and strong revenue contribution during key seasonal peaks.
The Digital Performance team consistently acted as Adidas Germany’s primary conversion engine, with SEM and Retargeting driving the majority of lower-funnel revenue.
Paid Search campaigns on Google remained the most efficient channel, repeatedly achieving ROAS above 8 across multiple seasonal peaks.
DV360 retargeting delivered strong mid-funnel reinforcement, supporting final conversions captured through Always-On Search.
In Q2, Digital Performance campaigns contributed nearly 45% of all Adidas.com purchases, highlighting their dominance in the D2C sales funnel.
Retargeting across Meta and Criteo helped recover high-intent shoppers, although Meta occasionally struggled to convert cold audiences efficiently.
Across 2025, Adizero SL was one of the top D2C performers due to high-intent traffic captured through Always-On Search.
The Running Performance Push campaign improved significantly mid-year, with ROAS increasing after audience optimization.
Despite smaller budgets, TikTok retargeting delivered strong ROAS when paired with high-quality creative assets.
The Digital Performance team played a crucial role in monetizing demand generated by Digital Brand upper-funnel campaigns.
Conversion-led campaigns performed exceptionally during promotions, with SEM capturing most incremental purchase intent.
CRM continued to deliver outsized commercial impact, converting loyal Adidas members at much higher efficiency than paid digital channels.
Email-triggered journeys executed through Salesforce proved highly predictable, driving recurring purchases even during non-peak months.
The CRM team generated 5% of all attributed revenue despite representing only 4% of annual spend.
The Adidas Membership Program ensured stable purchase behavior and reduced volatility in digital performance.
CRM’s retention-focused messaging helped maintain engagement among high-value consumers during Q3.
Digital Brand campaigns prioritized reach and consideration, with platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube delivering massive exposure.
CTR performance varied by creative theme, with Running Social Video outperforming lifestyle creatives in several months.
Brand-led seasonal pushes like Spring and Summer collections helped sustain consumer interest ahead of major launches.
TikTok delivered stronger engagement among younger audiences, while YouTube excelled in broad national reach.
DOOH formats outperformed classic OOH in revenue contribution thanks to dynamic creative and high-footfall placements.
OOH placements supported retail uplift by reinforcing physical store messaging during major product drops.
TVCs on RTL and ProSieben offered the broadest linear reach for Originals and Running categories.
High-frequency TV campaigns maintained consistent GRP delivery throughout peak retail periods.
In several months, DOOH generated higher-than-expected ROAS, especially when paired with digital retargeting.
Retail Marketing contributed meaningfully to store uplift, reinforcing both online and offline journeys.
Sports Marketing activations delivered visibility during major events, supported by athlete-driven content.
Sports Marketing played a key role in building cultural relevance for Samba and Predator franchises.
Digital channels gained a larger share of Adidas Germany’s total marketing budget in 2025.
Marketing efficiency improved year-over-year as multiple teams exceeded prior benchmarks for ROAS and revenue contribution.
2025 results validated the acceleration of Adidas Germany’s digital transformation, with nearly half of attributed revenue coming from digital-first campaigns.
